selection: Soft-drink rows the lane stated with a drink name whose ledger key (pub, category, name, serving) the ledger did not already hold. Rows matching a reviewed withdrawal reason are listed under withheld and were not published. Rows whose label names no drink, or names a mixer flavour from a mixer list, are listed under notSelected and were not published.
